lessons: Artifact digest verification is insufficient unless the verifier also closes the release-bundle inventory over every regular file and symlink.

Fail-closed hardening can change which guard rejects an unsafe input first; regression tests should assert the safety property rather than brittle exact error wording when ordering is not part of the contract.
A failing initial CI head is useful evidence when it blocks merge and exposes a stale test assumption; only the corrected exact final head may be used for a readiness claim.
